title: Week 4 Graded-Capacity Check-In
subtitle: Review one meaningful challenge and what its response taught you.
description: The goal is not a perfect symptom response. It is to learn how attention, emotion, movement strategy, dose, and recovery affect participation.

sections.title: Choose the activity
sections.description: Use one activity that matters in your real life.

fields.label: The activity I practised:
fields.placeholder: Walking, lifting, sitting, work, sport, parenting, chores...

fields.label: My starting dose or step:
fields.placeholder: How much, how long, or which version?

fields.label: Why did this activity matter to me?
fields.placeholder: Connect it to function, independence, work, recreation, or another value...

sections.title: Review the response
sections.description: Look at more than pain intensity alone.

fields.label: What did I notice during and after the activity?
fields.placeholder: Symptoms, confidence, control, function, emotion, and recovery...

fields.label: What might I do next?
options: Progress one part of the dose
Use another regulation or recovery strategy

fields.label: What information supports that decision?
fields.placeholder: Explain the pattern in your own words...

sections.title: Notice the response loop
sections.description: Attention and emotion can shape actions without making symptoms imaginary.

fields.label: A thought or emotion I noticed:
The action it pulled me toward:
fields.placeholder: Avoid, brace, rush, test, adjust, ask for help...

fields.label: A useful response I can practise next time:

successMessage: Week 4 complete. You are learning how to select, review, and adjust meaningful recovery challenges.
